title: Staff panel
unavailable: The staff panel isn't set up for this copy of the site.

login.title: Staff login
login.intro: For Seoul-Mate Minimart staff. Accounts are created by the owner.
login.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
login.network: We couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
login.idle: You were logged out after 60 minutes without activity.
login.expired: You were logged out because 12 hours have passed since you logged in.
login.notStaff: This account can't use the staff panel. Ask the owner to add it.

mfa.title: Enter your code
mfa.intro: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for Seoul-Mate Minimart.
mfa.wrong: Wrong code. Check your app and try again.
mfa.codeFormat: Enter the 6 digits from your app

items.title: Items
items.markAllTitle: Mark all items out of stock?
items.markAllBody_one: {{count}} item is in stock now. Visitors will see it as out of stock until you switch it back.
items.markAllBody_other: {{count}} items are in stock now. Visitors will see them as out of stock until you switch them back.
items.nothingToMark: Every item is already out of stock.
items.empty: No items yet. Add the first one.

form.translationHint: Leave empty to show the English text.
form.name: Name
form.publishedHint: Hidden items are only visible here.
form.deleteBody: The item and its photo are removed for good. This can't be undone.
form.photoSaveFailed: Saved {{name}}, but the photo couldn't be uploaded. Try adding it again.
form.notFound: This item doesn't exist any more.

photo.label: Photo
photo.hint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB. It's resized and its location data removed before upload.
photo.willRemove: The photo will be removed when you save.
photo.wrongType: Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP photo.
photo.tooLarge: This photo is over 5 MB. Choose a smaller one.
photo.unreadable: This photo couldn't be read. Try another one.
photo.processedTooLarge: This photo is too detailed to upload. Try another one.

categories.title: Categories
categories.intro: Categories group items on the menu, in this order.
categories.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes. Used in filter links such as ?category=instant-noodles.
categories.deleteBody: The category is removed from the menu. This can't be undone.
categories.cannotDelete: {{name}} still has items. Move them to another category or delete them first.
categories.empty: No categories yet. Add the first one.

security.title: Security
security.statusOn: Two-factor login is on. You enter a code from your authenticator app each time you log in.
security.statusOff: Two-factor login is off. Turn it on so a stolen password alone can't open the staff panel.
security.required: The owner requires two-factor login for your account. Until it's on, you can't change the menu.
security.step1: Open an authenticator app, such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator, and scan this code.
security.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
security.secret: Can't scan it? Enter this key in the app instead:
security.step2: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
security.turnOffBody: Your password alone will open the staff panel again.

errors.permission: You don't have permission to do that. Please log in again.
errors.network: We couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong, and nothing was saved. Try again.
errors.slugTaken: Another category already uses this web address name.
errors.price: Enter a price in pesos, such as 95 or 95.50
errors.slugFormat: Use lowercase letters, numbers and single dashes, up to 40 characters
